title: AccessSaves
description: This mod adds a button that opens your world saves folder.
body:
This mod adds a vanilla style button that opens your world saves folder.

This mod only needs to be installed on the client and does not require and additional libraries to be installed (apart from the Fabric API).

![The button is located next to the "Create New World" button](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/34019a361b34220d79951e172d01baea950d3caf.png)
